rows.question: Among the players with an overall rating between 60 to 65, how many players whose going to be in all of your attack moves instead of defensing?

rows.question: Who are the top 5 players who perform better in crossing actions? Indicate their player id.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT T1.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
WHERE T1.crossing IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.crossing DESC
LIMIT 5

rows.question: Which league had the most goals in the 2016 season?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M
  ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', M.date) = '2016'
GROUP BY
  L.name
ORDER BY
  SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Which home team had lost the fewest matches in the 2016 season?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  T2.team_long_name
FROM Match AS T1
JOIN Team AS T2
  ON T1.home_team_api_id = T2.id
WHERE
  T1.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY
  T2.team_long_name
ORDER BY
  SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Indicate the full names of the top 10 players with the highest number of penalties.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE
  pa.free_kick_accuracy > 0
GROUP BY
  p.player_name
ORDER BY
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN pa.free_kick_accuracy > 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) DESC
LIMIT 10

rows.question: In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  T2.team_short_name
FROM
  Team AS T2
JOIN League AS L
  ON T2.team_api_id = L.country_id
JOIN Match AS M
  ON T2.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', M.date) = '2009'
  AND M.match_api_id IN (492473, 492474)
GROUP BY
  T2.team_short_name
ORDER BY
  COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Give the name of the league with the highest matches of all time and how many matches were played in the said league.

rows.question: Calculate the percentage of players who prefer left foot, who were born between 1987 and 1992.
rows.pred_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "preferred_foot" = 'left' AND STRFTIME('%Y', "birthday") BETWEEN '1987-01-01' AND '1992-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM Player WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL

rows.question: List the top 5 leagues in ascending order of the number of goals made in all seasons combined.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  L.name,
  SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM "Match" AS M
JOIN "League" AS L
  ON M."league_id" = L.id
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5
